questions.question: Where must placards be placed on a vehicle carrying hazardous cargo?

options.text: On the front, rear, and sides

questions.correctAnswerText: On the front, rear, and sides
questions.explanation: Placards must be placed on all four sides of a vehicle carrying hazardous cargo. They must be visible from any direction.

questions.question: How often must hazardous materials employees be trained and tested?
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials employees must be trained and tested at least once every three years. Training must cover how to recognize and respond to security threats.

questions.question: When crossing traffic in a combination vehicle, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will make room for you
Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to safely cross

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to safely cross
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles need more space than other vehicles. Always wait for a large enough gap in traffic to safely enter or cross.

questions.question: In cold weather, bridges usually freeze:

options.text: After other parts of the roadway
Before other parts of the roadway
At the same time as other parts of the roadway

questions.correctAnswerText: Before other parts of the roadway
questions.explanation: Bridges freeze before other road surfaces in cold weather. Use extra caution on bridges and overpasses when driving in cold, wet conditions.

questions.question: An empty combination vehicle with stiff suspension springs and strong brakes will have:
questions.explanation: An empty combination vehicle has less weight, so the suspension and brakes have lower traction. It will take longer to stop than a fully loaded vehicle.

questions.question: If you find a leaking tank, you should:

options.text: Continue the trip and report it later

questions.explanation: It is illegal to transport gas or liquid in a leaking tank. Always get leaks fixed right away before continuing.

questions.question: When ice begins to melt in cool weather, the road:

options.text: Is usually safe to drive on

questions.explanation: Melting ice creates water on top of the remaining ice, making roads more slippery. Always reduce speed and drive carefully on slippery surfaces.

questions.question: What is road rage?

options.text: Driving with intent to harm others
Driving a vehicle that has not been inspected

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving with intent to harm others
questions.explanation: Road rage means driving with the intent to harm another driver or damage their vehicle. This is different from aggressive driving, which is reckless or selfish driving.

questions.question: When driving in wet conditions, a lack of spray from other vehicles' tires indicates:

options.text: Ice has formed on the road
The spray is trapped under the vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: Ice has formed on the road
questions.explanation: When there is no spray from tires in wet conditions, ice has likely formed. Be extra careful when driving in wet, freezing weather.

questions.question: Rollovers happen when:
questions.explanation: Rollovers happen when drivers turn too fast. To prevent rollovers, drive slowly on ramps and around corners. Avoid quick lane changes when towing trailers.

questions.question: What is the name for a thin layer of ice that forms on road surfaces?
questions.explanation: Black ice is a thin, clear layer of ice on the road. You can see the road through it, so it may look wet instead of icy. Be very careful when it is below freezing and the road looks wet.

questions.question: The service air line is controlled by the foot brake and connects to the ____ valves.
questions.explanation: The service air line carries air and is controlled by the foot brake or trailer hand brake. It connects to relay valves, which help the trailer brakes work quickly.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a vehicle inspection report?

options.text: Tell the motor carrier about problems that need to be fixed
Make sure the vehicle is inspected on a regular schedule
Hold people responsible for inspecting the vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell the motor carrier about problems that need to be fixed
questions.explanation: A vehicle inspection report informs the carrier about any problems that need to be fixed.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is safe to drive on a tire missing one or two lug nuts
A cracked lock ring on a rim is safe if you drive slower than 55 mph
A missing clamp on a rim is dangerous and must be fixed

questions.correctAnswerText: A missing clamp on a rim is dangerous and must be fixed
questions.explanation: Missing clamps, spacers, studs, or lugs are dangerous. Cracked or bent lock rings are also dangerous. Check that your tires and rims are in good condition before driving a commercial vehicle.

questions.question: When loading liquid cargo, you should consider the ____.
questions.explanation: When loading liquid cargo, consider how much the liquid will expand during transport, its weight, and legal weight limits.

questions.question: Where should a hazardous material's identification number appear?

options.text: On a sticker near the shipping container

questions.explanation: The ID number must appear on the shipping papers and on the packaging. It must also appear on cargo tanks and other bulk containers.

questions.question: How should you put out an electrical fire?
questions.explanation: B:C fire extinguishers work on electrical fires and burning liquids. Do not use water on an electrical fire.

questions.question: How often should you check your mirrors?

options.text: Only if you suspect a problem

questions.explanation: Check your mirrors regularly while driving. This helps you stay aware of traffic and watch for problems on your vehicle.

questions.question: During a pre-trip inspection, fresh oil under your vehicle is:
questions.explanation: When checking under your vehicle before a trip, look for fresh oil, coolant, grease, or fuel leaks. Finding any of these is a sign of a problem.

questions.question: How many hours of sleep does an adult need each night to stay alert?
questions.explanation: Getting enough rest is important for safe driving. Most people need eight to nine hours of sleep each night to stay alert.
